name: Magus Warrior of Fortune
body:
Improbable Magus (Ex)

At 4th level, gain an improbable ability from the luckbringer class (using arcane pool points in place of moments of chance). Replaces spell recall.

Improbable Arcana

Critically Lucky (gain Critical Focus or Improved Critical on the fly), Entropy Shield (20% to 50% ranged miss chance), Fateful Footing (+10 speed/+2 Dex to self; -10 speed/-2 Dex to foe), Good Karma (redirect adjacent ally attack to self), Hazard (inflict 1d6/2 levels hazard damage; Reflex half), Ill-Fortune (target 50% action fail next round), Improved Weal and Woe (+2/-2 modifier), Jinx (missed attacks have 20% hit chance), Just a Scratch (heal level + Int HP), Opportunity Knocks (extra AoO or suppress AoO), Twist the Pattern (take 10 swift, take 20 full-round on skill checks).
